title: World Cup 2026: France and Morocco prepare for quarter-final clash
summary: For the second World Cup in a row, France and Morocco meet again in the knockout stage. Both teams are preparing for another intense battle, with several players on either side having shared the dressing room at Paris Saint-Germain.
